kurz: Almonds, chocolate, sugar and egg white without flour: baked short and hot they stay soft inside and turn slightly firm outside.
bild_im_kopf: Like a chocolate with a coat: a thin crust outside, soft as marzipan inside.

schluesselmomente.schritt: Knead almonds, sugar, cocoa or melted chocolate and egg white into a dough
schluesselmomente.warum: The egg white binds, the sugar holds moisture. Without flour no gluten forms, and the dough stays tender.

schluesselmomente.schritt: Roll out on sugar and cut out
schluesselmomente.warum: Sugar instead of flour stops sticking and gives a fine, crisp surface.

schluesselmomente.schritt: Leave to dry for a few hours or overnight
schluesselmomente.warum: The surface dries into a skin that holds the shape in the oven.

schluesselmomente.schritt: Bake at high heat, about 250 °C, for just 3–5 minutes (as a guide)
schluesselmomente.warum: The short, strong heat only firms the outside. Baked longer, they would turn hard.
